passive_description.localized:
Increases Crit Rate by <lv>{0}</>.
Increases the wearer's Redirect Skill DMG by <lv>{1}</>. Increases the wearer's Basic Attack DMG by <lv>{2}</> and Lakshana DMG by <lv>{3}</> for <lv>{4}</>s after casting a Redirect Skill.
passive_description.source:
暴击率提升<lv>{0}</>。
装备者的「变轨技能」造成的伤害提高<lv>{1}</>；装备者在释放「变轨技能」后，自身「普通攻击」造成的伤害提高<lv>{2}</>，并获得<lv>{3}</>相属性伤害提升，持续<lv>{4}</>秒。

placeholder_mapping.{2}: buff_Prism_DamageUp2 (DataList order 3, ratio): Basic Attack (A-category) DMG, 15s window
placeholder_mapping.{3}: buff_Prism_LakshanaUp (DataList order 4, ratio): Lakshana DMG, 15s window

world-time duration expires before an equal-time hit and a later delivered packet samples current buff state
input role triggers the window; delivered native category and element independently select bonuses
